title: Fire Alarm Year
about: A year remembered for repeated nighttime fire alarms and the friends who stayed behind to help me on the stairs.
description: This track remembers the year when repeated fire alarms kept sending everyone out of the dorms in the middle of the night. With a broken ankle and my scooter unable to handle the stairs, evacuating took me much longer than everyone else. Friends stayed with me and helped instead of leaving me behind. The alarms became an exhausted running joke, but what lasted most was the memory of people making sure I never had to handle those nights alone.
lyrics: Half asleep we grabbed our shoes,
Heard the sirens start to call.
No one knew what caused the sound,
Down the stairs they all could run...
Mine were climbed one step at a time.
It was the Fire Alarm Year,
Every time we thought, "This one's real,"
By the fifth time someone joked,
Friends would stay behind with me,
No one complained, no one sighed,
When I couldn't move as fast,
They made sure I still got home.
It was the Fire Alarm Year,
Every time we thought, "This one's real,"
By the fifth time someone joked,
Sometimes it's standing in the dark,
Knowing we'd be back in bed...
It was the Fire Alarm Year,
Not because of smoke or flames,
Just all the nights we never slept.
I still smile a little more.
They just keep knocking at the door.
